title: Beachside Kiss Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Sink into a Romantic Weekend at the Seaside Cottage ‘Beachside Kiss’! Conveniently located in Seaside, FL’s town square, this three-bedroom, two-bathroom beach home is perfect for your next getaway.
description_expanded: Description159 EAST RUSKIN STREET2 KINGS, 1 BUNK, QUEEN SLEEPER SOFABeachside Kiss | Classic Seaside Cottage Near Town SquareEscape to the heart of Seaside, Florida, and discover Beachside Kiss, a beautifully appointed three-bedroom, two-bath beach cottage that blends relaxed coastal living with timeless Seaside charm. Perfect for a romantic weekend, a family vacation, or a friends’ getaway, this inviting home is ideally located just a short walk from Seaside’s iconic town square, surrounded by pastel cottages, brick-lined streets, and the walkable magic that defines this beloved 30A community.Prime Walkable Location in Seaside, FloridaNestled among Seaside’s storybook streets, Beachside Kiss places you moments from boutique shopping, dining, live music, and the beach. Leave the car parked and enjoy the ease of strolling or biking to everything Seaside has to offer—from sunrise beach walks to evening concerts in the square.Welcoming Front Porch & Open Living SpacesStart your mornings on the spacious front porch, outfitted with brand-new lounge seating and perfect for coffee, conversation, or people-watching as Seaside comes to life. Inside, the open-concept living area is warm and inviting, featuring a generous sectional sofa, a large flat-screen HD TV, and a dining area with seating for eight—ideal for gathering after a sun-filled day.Fully Equipped Gourmet KitchenThe gourmet kitchen is designed for both ease and inspiration, featuring stainless steel appliances, ample counter space, and a full set of high-quality Emeril Lagasse pots and pans. Whether you’re cooking a family dinner or assembling beach-day snacks, this kitchen has everything you need for effortless entertaining.Florida Room for Flexible LivingJust off the dining area, the light-filled Florida room offers additional versatility. This airy space includes a queen sleeper sofa and cozy seating and can be curtained off for privacy—making it ideal as a fourth sleeping area, a quiet reading nook, or a relaxing spot for evening cocktails.Peaceful Bedroom Wing for Rest & RelaxationTucked away from the main living spaces, the bedroom wing offers a serene retreat. The king primary suite features a flat-screen TV, generous closet space, and a private ensuite bathroom with a marble sink, soaking tub, and shower—perfect for unwinding after beach days.A second king guest bedroom is tastefully furnished and includes a flat-screen TV discreetly housed in a classic armoire. The third sleeping space features a built-in twin bunk bed, ideal for younger guests or those young at heart. These two rooms share a spacious hallway bathroom with granite countertops and a shower/tub combination.Outdoor Shower & Additional Guest OptionsAfter a day at the beach, rinse off in the outdoor shower located on the back deck, adding convenience and comfort to your stay. For larger groups or extended family, the nearby guest house Moonlight Hug is also available to rent, offering additional accommodations just steps away.Your Effortless Seaside, Florida GetawayWhether you’re planning a romantic escape, a memorable family vacation, or a peaceful retreat by the sea, Beachside Kiss delivers comfort, charm, and an unbeatable Seaside location. With inviting indoor spaces, outdoor living areas, and easy access to all things Seaside, this cottage makes every stay feel effortlessly special.Need More Room?Beachside Kiss has a guest house named Moonlight Hug available to rent year-round that sleeps 2 guests!* 5 night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3 night minimum Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES 1,472 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spacePrivate residential Seaside beach access at East Ruskin PavilionSeaside offers the largest residential private beach on Scenic Highway 30ALocated just 352 yards (approximately a 4-minute walk) to beach accessPeacock Alley linens throughout the home, featuring fresh, luxurious sheets and plush towelsAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fully equipped fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes available for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes (golf carts are considered vehicles)Golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside; special circumstances or medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002378
